2026_05_IND_PIT.headline: Taylor challenges Pittsburgh’s middle as Rodgers and Jones prepare for pressure
2026_05_IND_PIT.paragraph1: Indianapolis can press Pittsburgh’s defensive interior with Jonathan Taylor, especially if wet conditions make ball security and footing more important. T.J. Watt and the Steelers can counter by controlling their rush lanes and forcing Daniel Jones to throw without a clean pocket. On the other side, Aaron Rodgers needs steadier first-down completions to avoid Indianapolis disguising pressure with DeForest Buckner up front. Shane Steichen’s wet-ball preparations give the Colts a practical response if rain disrupts either offense’s timing.
2026_05_IND_PIT.model_rationale: Taylor's rushing demands sound gap discipline from Pittsburgh, and the Colts must limit turnovers under pressure. Rodgers can answer with early completions before Indianapolis disguises its pass rush.
